in_hebrew.name: Allistir
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Rule of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Allistir הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Ἀλλοστόρικος (Allostorikos), meaning 'other-ruler' or 'rule of God'. In early Christian use, this name was given to those who ruled in the name of God or to those who were protectors of the faith.
